// MACROCORE™ TECHNOLOGY DNA

TOTAL AIR INTAKE DEFENSE

MACROCORE™ / MEDIA
ABRASIVE CAPTURE

Multi-layer synthetic media engineered for 99.9% particle retention, preventing silica and carbon deposits from reaching critical engine components.

MACROCORE™ / SEAL
ZERO BYPASS

Structural integrity sealing eliminates bypass pathways — ensuring 100% of intake air passes through the filtration media under all operating conditions.

Low restriction design maintains maximum engine power output while delivering absolute contamination control in high-dust environments.

MACROCORE™ / STRUCTURE
COLLAPSE RESISTANCE

Heavy-duty center tube and pleat geometry prevent media collapse under severe pulsation and high-vacuum conditions in turbocharged engines.

EXTENDED LIFE

Extended service intervals reduce maintenance costs and downtime — delivering up to 40% longer service life versus conventional air filtration systems.
